_pm_rulings_applied: 08.06.26 (A4) - Section 02 41 00 goes in both RFP-002 and RFP-008, split by what each demolishes. RFP-002 carries the abandoned elementary school abatement and building wrecking; RFP-008 carries the sports field site demolition.

08.06.26 (D - GLOBAL RULE) - Section 02 81 00 (Transportation and Disposal of Misc. Hazardous Materials) is absent from the Project Manual and is not cited by number. The obligation is carried in scope verbiage instead.

rule 14 - Do not restate the specs and drawings. 15 of the narrative's General Scope Requirements and demolition-procedure items were struck as duplicates of Section 02 41 00 Part 3 or the ES demolition plan notes. What survives is the trade boundary and the obligations the documents do not otherwise carry.

rule 14a - Exhibit B, Basis of GMP is an Owner-side agreement and is out of the DIRECTIVES list and out of every citation. Its scope assumption and its two relevant exclusions (buildings to remain; underground utilities outside building footprints) are written as plain scope statements instead.
rule 16 - Exclusions start empty. Three are kept, each because a demolition/abatement subcontractor bidding a 7-building campus would ordinarily assume it without a stated boundary.
rule 17 - Spec section carries number and description only. Directives are zero-padded with no dates or qualifiers. Paragraphs 27 and 28 are always kept.
D4 - Supply and install / coordinate verbs used per the corpus majority; no 'Provide and install' construction in this trade.
07.31.26 - RFI responses issued with Addendum #1 are contract documents and bind the Subcontractor; Clarifications #1 and #2 are directives Northstar acknowledged in both proposal submissions.

scope_groups.header: Hazardous Material Remediation (Abandoned Elementary School) - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Remove and legally dispose of hazardous building materials at the abandoned elementary school (Idaho Circle), including all trucking and disposal fees.
Includes transportation and disposal of miscellaneous hazardous materials encountered during this Scope of Work.
Includes pre-abatement demolition of interior finishes, materials, equipment, and building components necessary to access hazardous materials, including off-haul and disposal to a legal landfill.
Includes stabilization of lead-based paint surfaces requiring removal.
Comply with the Pre-Demolition Asbestos Survey (dated October 3, 2023) and the Asbestos Management Plan for Nye County School District (dated January 4, 2022).
Provide, manage, maintain, and remove all containment, negative air pressurization, and HEPA filtration systems.
Limited to Buildings 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7; Buildings 1 and 2 remain occupied throughout this Scope of Work.

scope_groups.header: Building Wrecking (Abandoned Elementary School) - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Demolish and remove Buildings 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 at the abandoned elementary school (Idaho Circle) as indicated, including all interior finishes, materials, equipment, and building system components.
Slabs-on-grade to remain; cut all reinforcing, anchor bolts, conduits, and piping flush with top of slab as indicated.
Cast-in-place concrete basement retaining wall at Building 4 to remain as indicated.
Includes removal of all plumbing, mechanical, and electrical equipment disconnected by others.
Demolish and remove existing wooden shed and floor structure at Building 4.

Cut and remove existing exterior wood posts at Building 5; remove and salvage existing exterior steel canopy posts, coordinating with Contractor for protection, storage, and re-installation by others.
Demolish and remove exterior walkway canopies as indicated.
Includes all sawcutting necessary to complete this Scope of Work.
Cut and cap water and sewer lines a minimum 24 inches below finish slab as indicated.

scope_groups.header: Site Clearing (Abandoned Elementary School Campus) - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Sawcut and remove all concrete paving, steps-on-grade, and equipment pads as indicated.
Remove trees, including stump grinding, as indicated.
Demolish and remove landscaping, including shut-off of irrigation, sprinklers, and the main water line as indicated.
Remove and dispose of existing chain link fencing and gates, handrails, playground equipment, and basketball hoops and posts, including all footings.
Fill open stem wall CMU cells with dirt as indicated, per 1/AD1.15.
Provide rough site grading at completion, including backfilling footing holes and excavated trenches with native materials.
Remove and haul off existing propane tank and associated piping.
Coordinate with Electrical Subcontractor for safe-off of feeders from the transformer to the demolished buildings; remove, haul, and dispose of feeders outside building footprints.
Cap abandoned water line as required.
Provide traffic control plans, flagging, and barricades for offsite activities required for this Scope of Work only; obtain required offsite excavation and traffic control permits.
Provide dust palliative as indicated at completion of work at this site.
Includes all provisions for confined space work as may be required.
Provide dust control for all operations per Nye County Air Quality requirements.
Clean and maintain trucking access routes, including street sweeping, for this Scope of Work only.
Coordinate with Utility, Plumbing, Mechanical, and Electrical Subcontractors to ensure utilities are capped and made safe prior to demolition within the building envelope.

exclusions: Abatement or demolition of Buildings 1 and 2
Underground utility demolition and relocation outside building footprints
Building 4 lower-level stem wall demolition, AD1.16 alternate

_open_pm_items.title: Section 02 41 00 claimed by more than one scope doc
_open_pm_items.detail: Carried forward from the package record. Resolved by PM ruling 08.06.26 (A4): the section is cited in both RFP-002 and RFP-008, split by what each demolishes. RFP-002's citation here covers only the abandoned elementary school abatement and building wrecking.

_open_pm_items.title: NorthStar's price does not actually move between 05.12.26 and 05.15.26
_open_pm_items.detail: The package record flagged $718,623 (05.12.26) moving to $718,263 (05.15.26) as a possible price change. Reading the actual submitted PDF resolves it: the 05.12.26 BuildingConnected cover page reads $718,623, but the signed Subcontractor Proposal Form inside that same submission already states $718,263.00 in both numerals and words. The 05.15.26 Homework Response repeats $718,263.00 exactly. The $718,623 figure is a BuildingConnected portal transcription, not a second price. $718,263.00 is the base bid throughout.

_open_pm_items.title: Asbestos survey date matches the staged file
_open_pm_items.detail: Carried forward from the package record. The EICS Pre-Demolition Asbestos Survey is dated October 3, 2023 (report date) with field sampling on September 19, 2023; the staged file '04.03 - Asbestos Survey_EICS 100323.pdf' is consistent. Quantities beyond that survey are excluded by both the narrative and every bidder; the survey's own quantities are the contractual baseline.

_open_pm_items.title: $307 gap between the priced buildup and the GMP-carried amount
_open_pm_items.detail: Base Bid $718,263.00 + Alternate 002.02 $23,342.00 = $741,605.00. The Procore budget and GMP BackSheet both carry $741,912.00 for phase code 02-1110-10000 with zero delta against each other, but $307 more than the buildup this record can trace. No combination of NorthStar's own remaining alternates (Alt 1 transite pipe, Alt 3 dust palliative $16,000, Alt 4 Building 4 lower level $21,125) closes the gap cleanly. The Subcontract Amount in this draft is the carried $741,912.00 per the document authority hierarchy (GMP outranks the proposal); the $307 needs a source before the subcontract issues.

_open_pm_items.title: Spec 02 4100 conflicts with the drawings on slab removal
_open_pm_items.detail: Section 02 41 00 para 3.01.I requires 'Remove concrete slabs on grade within site boundaries.' The Scope of Work narrative ('Slabs-on-grade to remain') and every ES demolition sheet (AD1.11 through AD1.16, keynote/note 1: 'EXISTING BUILDING TO BE DEMOLISHED, EXISTING SLABS TO REMAIN IN PLACE') agree the slabs stay. This draft carries the narrative/drawing direction, which is the more specific and more recently confirmed instrument, but the conflict with the generic spec section is unresolved and worth a documented ruling before issue.

_open_pm_items.title: Two bidder files on this package do not describe abatement/demolition work
_open_pm_items.detail: Environmental Protection Services' filing under package #002 describes SWPPP/erosion-control and hydroseeding services, not abatement or demolition. Alliance's filing carries an extraction date (2023-10-03) inconsistent with a 05.12.26 bid submission. Neither was relied on for scope grounding; flagged in case either is a misfiled document that belongs to a different package.

review_appendix._purpose: PM request 08.11.26. Rule 14 strips every obligation the specs and drawings already carry. This lists what was stripped so the PM can put any of it back. Draft only - build with --final to suppress it.
intro: Rule 14 keeps out of this exhibit anything the Contract Documents already state, so the Subcontract carries one copy of each obligation rather than two that can drift.

Every line below was drafted, verified and then removed on that basis. All of them still bind the Subcontractor through the document named beneath them. Tick any that should be restated in the Scope of Work above.
